newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee reroutes gas on 500 line.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee reroutes gas on 500 line.

text.p: Tenneco unit Tennessee Gas Pipeline said a mechanical failure at its DeKalb, Miss. gas compressor station caused the company to reroute about 200 million cubic feet per day on its 500 line.

"Tennessee is meeting its transportation commitments by rerouting about 200 mmcfd of natural gas from nearby interconnects. The company does not anticipate any impact on customer deliveries as a result of the outage," the company said in a statement Wednesday.
A company spokeswoman said a valve failure Tuesday night at the station caused the shutdown.
She was not sure how long it would take to repair or replace the affected equipment.
Tennessee has made producers who ship gas on the 500 line upstream of station 542 aware that pipeline pressure will be higher than normal until the situation is corrected, the statement said.
